c: You order: the request is Pending Approval and you get Request REQ… was created.
say: When you order, the request is pending approval, and you get an email saying it was created.

c: Approved, it moves on; a rejection closes it as Closed Rejected.
say: Once approved, it moves on, and you are told. If it is rejected, it closes as closed rejected.

c: Each item has its own stage, starting with its approvals.
say: Each item in it has its own stage, starting with its approvals: your manager, then the department head.

c: Order Fulfillment: it's being bought or prepared.
say: In order fulfillment, it is being bought or prepared.

c: Deployment: you get Your requested RITM… is being delivered.
say: In deployment, it is on its way, and you get an email saying it is being delivered.

c: When all its items are done, the request is Closed Complete.
say: When all its items are done, the request closes as complete, and you get a last email.
